key_insight: A well-balanced WE-PINN formulation exactly preserves lake-at-rest equilibria in its discrete residual over smooth and discontinuous bathymetry.
engineering_relevance: The method enables mesh-free shallow-water modeling without spurious equilibrium disturbances caused by imperfect flux–bed-slope balance.
method: Enforce weak space–time conservation on randomly placed, potentially overlapping control volumes without differentiating the network.
Integrate the geometric source by parts and correct local bed slopes so quadrature reproduces exact bed increments.
Use independent networks across bed discontinuities, coupled by conservation of discharge and total head.
evidence_signal: Four lake-at-rest configurations produced residuals at round-off, while seven bottom-step Riemann problems achieved relative L1 free-surface errors of 6.9×10⁻⁴–3.5×10⁻³ and reached critical states without prescribing them.
watch_item: Exact equilibrium preservation by the residual does not guarantee rapid training convergence; reaching equilibrium to round-off required an extended training budget.
paper_title: Well-Balanced WE-PINNs for the Shallow Water Equations over Smooth and Discontinuous Bathymetries
